issues: Debug title COUNTER TICK SPARKS, gray skeleton bars, a 2px gray-bordered white card, Helvetica fallback, and only a 168px number
Sparks were scattered randomly along the whole top edge, so you couldn't tell which digit ticked — it read as decoration
An even ease-out count gave no dense-to-sparse suspense; the final tick differed from the others only in spark count
Sparks died mid-air with no landing or space, and after the final value only a card remained
changes: Look switched to graphite: near-monochrome dark stage with a mirror-black floor; 300px brushed-metal digits stand on it, digits and sparks reflected, a cool horizon line on the floor

Content is now a live public-beta waitlist counting 42,380 → 60,000 (always five digits); thousands/ten-thousands are bright metal, the running tail is dimmed 45% and speed-blurred, then lights up at the end

Sparks now have a source: on each thousand the digit that just ticked flashes white-hot and cools to metal (7f decay), 8–12 sparks fan out from its top, bounce once on the floor (restitution 0.38) and die, cooling white → gold → dark orange
Count curve is power-out 2.3: 17 ticks spread from every 2–3f to 25f for the last thousand (suspense); the final value fires 64 large sparks, a spring pop, a floor shock ring and a warm light pool
LIVE eyebrow tracks in, the caption is present from the start, and a second line 'Doors open Monday.' rises after the final value; 140→160f with ≥22f clean tail
